---
title: "Skills"
---

Skills for Claude Code and other coding agents. Each skill is a directory with a
`SKILL.md` file. The source is in the
[skills directory](https://github.com/paulrougieux/paulrougieux.github.io/tree/master/skills)
of this site's repository.

# Install

Download one skill into your personal skills directory, for example `spell`:

    mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/spell
    curl -o ~/.claude/skills/spell/SKILL.md \
        https://paulrougieux.github.io/skills/spell/SKILL.md

Or clone the repository and link the skill directories, see the
[skills section](llm.html#skills) of the LLM page.

# List of skills

```{r skills, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Read the description field from the YAML front matter of a SKILL.md file.
# Descriptions can continue on indented lines.
skill_description <- function(lines) {
    delims <- which(lines == "---")
    if (length(delims) < 2) return("")
    front <- lines[(delims[1] + 1):(delims[2] - 1)]
    start <- grep("^description:", front)
    if (length(start) == 0) return("")
    end <- start
    while (end < length(front) && grepl("^\\s", front[end + 1])) end <- end + 1
    desc <- paste(trimws(front[start:end]), collapse = " ")
    desc <- sub("^description:\\s*", "", desc)
    gsub('^"|"$', "", desc)
}

for (dir in sort(list.dirs("skills", recursive = FALSE))) {
    skill_file <- file.path(dir, "SKILL.md")
    if (!file.exists(skill_file)) next
    lines <- readLines(skill_file, warn = FALSE)
    cat("\n## ", basename(dir), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(skill_description(lines), "\n\n", sep = "")
    files <- list.files(dir, recursive = TRUE)
    links <- sprintf("[%s](%s/%s){download=\"%s\"}", files, dir, files, basename(files))
    cat("Download: ", paste(links, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("<details><summary>Show SKILL.md</summary>\n\n")
    cat("`````markdown\n", paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n`````\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("</details>\n\n")
}
```
